label: preparing
what: The innkeeper, Freight and builder are coordinating a community meal in the town hall great hall at eighteen hundred. I was initially told only of an inn matter and have since learned the meal description, but not its full particulars or original purpose. The secretary knowingly helps by scheduling and confirming the meeting; the baker appears involved in bread preparations, supported by the bread fundraising report and the innkeeper giving the baker a lantern, though that involvement is less certain. There is no reliable firsthand evidence for the rumoured bridge or port change.
